# Tech Faculty NG

> Tech Faculty NG trains, certifies and places Nigerians in tech careers: 10 departments online or at 22 campuses across Nigeria, a free foundation bootcamp, and SIWES industrial training placements. Licensed by the Federal Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (FMSTI) through the National Board for Technology Incubation (NBTI).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-llms.ts on every dev start and build. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Key facts

- Tech Faculty NG is a Nigerian technology training institute. Licensed by the Federal Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (FMSTI) through the National Board for Technology Incubation (NBTI).
- Headquarters: Technology Incubation Center, Onitsha-Okigwe Expressway, by Area Command, Umudim, Nnewi, Anambra State.
- Campuses: 22 centres in 19 states and the FCT (Nnewi, Awka, Onitsha, Owerri, Aba, Enugu, Abakaliki, Abuja, Lagos, Ibadan, Port Harcourt, Benin City, Kaduna, Kano, Jos, Bauchi, Makurdi, Uyo, Calabar, Sokoto, Ilorin, Akure). 20 of them operate inside NBTI Technology Incubation Centres.
- Departments: Web Development, Mobile App Development, Data Science & Analytics, Cybersecurity, AI & Machine Learning, Basic Internet & AI Studies, Social Media & Digital Marketing, Design, Cloud Computing, Robotics & IoT.
- Every department can be studied online, hybrid or in person.
- Free starting point: Basic Internet & AI Studies (4-6 weeks), no fee.
- Paid programmes are priced per module in naira and shown in US dollars outside Nigeria. Learning mode adds to the module total: online only is included, hybrid mode +₦12,000, physical classes +₦22,500.
- On-site SIWES at any campus: no separate placement fee. Learn & Pay students pay the regular course fee for their department, with up to 50% off for SIWES and IT students on request; Tutor & Earn students are paid. Virtual SIWES is charged because it covers courier delivery.
- Virtual SIWES (online industrial training placement): ₦45,000. Logbook review, signing, stamping and two-way courier delivery: ₦15,000.
- SIWES Success Kit: ₦4,500.
- Certificates are verifiable at https://techfaculty.ng/verify.
- Google rating for the Nnewi campus: 4.9 from 90 reviews (checked October 2026), https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJ5ZxSzmi9QxAR23OzR7YbAkM.
- Contact: WhatsApp +2348068597140, email thetechfaculty@gmail.com.
- Full detail in plain text, including programme prices and FAQ answers: https://techfaculty.ng/llms-full.txt

## Departments

- [Web Development](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/web-development): Learn front-end and full-stack web development with AI-assisted workflows. 12-16 weeks, beginner to advanced. 6 modules totalling ₦82,500 online. Students pay per module, and an order (modules, learning mode and add-ons) starts at ₦50,000.
- [Mobile App Development](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/mobile-app-development): Build and publish Android and iOS apps with React Native and Flutter. 14-18 weeks, intermediate. 6 modules totalling ₦105,000 online. Students pay per module, and an order (modules, learning mode and add-ons) starts at ₦80,000.
- [Data Science & Analytics](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/data-science-analytics): Turn raw data into dashboards and decisions with Excel, SQL, Power BI and Python. 12-16 weeks, beginner to advanced. 6 modules totalling ₦82,500 online. Students pay per module, and an order (modules, learning mode and add-ons) starts at ₦100,000.
- [Cybersecurity](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/cybersecurity): Train for SOC analyst, ethical hacking and compliance roles in Nigeria. 16-20 weeks, intermediate to advanced. 6 modules totalling ₦100,500 online. Students pay per module, and an order (modules, learning mode and add-ons) starts at ₦120,000.
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/ai-machine-learning): Build AI agents, RAG systems and machine learning models that ship. 16-20 weeks, advanced. 6 modules totalling ₦124,500 online. Students pay per module, and an order (modules, learning mode and add-ons) starts at ₦150,000.
- [Basic Internet & AI Studies](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/basic-internet-ai-studies): Digital literacy and everyday AI skills for complete beginners. 4-6 weeks, beginner. Free.
- [Social Media & Digital Marketing](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/digital-marketing): Grow brands with content, paid ads, SEO and AI-powered marketing. 10-14 weeks, beginner to intermediate. 6 modules totalling ₦72,000 online. Students pay per module, and an order (modules, learning mode and add-ons) starts at ₦60,000.
- [Design](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/design): Graphic design, UI/UX and product design with Figma and Adobe tools. 12-16 weeks, beginner to advanced. 6 modules totalling ₦78,000 online. Students pay per module, and an order (modules, learning mode and add-ons) starts at ₦70,000.
- [Cloud Computing](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/cloud-computing): Deploy, automate and secure infrastructure on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. 14-18 weeks, intermediate to advanced. 6 modules totalling ₦103,500 online. Students pay per module, and an order (modules, learning mode and add-ons) starts at ₦130,000.
- [Robotics & IoT](https://techfaculty.ng/departments/robotics-iot): Build robots, smart devices and embedded systems with Arduino and Raspberry Pi. 16-20 weeks, intermediate to advanced. Taken as a Custom Programme: students pick modules from any department, and an order starts at ₦50,000.

## SIWES and industrial training

- [SIWES and IT placement](https://techfaculty.ng/siwes): On site at our campuses with no separate placement fee: Learn & Pay (regular course fee, up to 50% off for SIWES students) or Tutor & Earn (paid).
- [Virtual SIWES](https://techfaculty.ng/virtual-siwes): Online IT placement for ₦45,000, plus logbook review, signing, stamping and two-way delivery for ₦15,000.
- [SIWES Success Kit](https://techfaculty.ng/siwes-success-kit): Everything a Nigerian student needs to land, survive and convert a SIWES placement. ₦4,500, with a free placement checklist.
